description: This file defines a migration class for a specific version of the OrangeHRM system. It extends an abstract migration class and provides versioning information, with no database changes in this particular migration.

classes.name: Migration
classes.description: Represents a database migration for version 4.1.2.1 of OrangeHRM, extending the abstract migration class and implementing version-specific methods.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Performs the migration; in this case, no database changes are needed in this version.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Returns the version string '4.1.2.1' for this migration.
